estimate.assumptions: Estimate from ordered path lengths at constant speeds: printing (incl. any retrace) at the print speed, every non-printing move (travel inside a piece and the transition to the next piece / layer, XY distance) at the travel speed, plus the estimated time of each frame reposition between lifts (if given). Not machine timing: acceleration, cornering, pump response, Z motion (manual today) and pauses are not included.
